transcript: Speaker A: How much buddy? Speaker B: It's 376 rupees. Please pay a little quickly because I have to deliver one more order to complete my whole day's target. Speaker A: Okay, but aapki English toh bahut accha hai. Kya aap English school se padhe hain? [Okay, but your English is very good. Did you study in an English school?] Speaker B: Nahi, main kabhi English school nahi gaya. English bolna toh maine English Seekho app se seekha hai. [No, I never went to an English school. I learned to speak English from the English Seekho app.] Speaker A: English Seekho app? What is this? Speaker B: English Seekho app spoken English ka best app hai, jahan ekdum basic level se word to word jodkar sentence banane se lekar advanced level ki farratedar English kaise bolni hai, sab kuch step-by-step bahut hi aasan bhasha mein experts dwara sikhaya jata hai. Aur haan madam, iska AI coach toh alag hi level ka coach hai, jiske sath koi bhi kabhi bhi English bolne ki one-on-one practice karke apni English ko farratedar bana sakta hai. English Seekho app ne mere jaise uneducated bande ko English bolna sikhakar sabit kar diya ki English kisi education ki mohtaj nahi hoti. [English Seekho app is the best spoken English app, where everything from basic word-to-word sentence building to advanced fluent English speaking is taught step-by-step in very simple language by experts. And yes madam, its AI coach is on another level, with which anyone can practice English speaking one-on-one anytime to make their English fluent. English Seekho app has proved by teaching an uneducated guy like me to speak English that English is not dependent on formal education.] Speaker A: Are wah! Yeh toh bahut accha app hai. India mein sabko English Seekho app zaroor download karna chahiye. [Wow! This is a very good app. Everyone in India should definitely download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: Log toh English Seekho app download kar lenge, lekin aap payment kijiye, order delay ho raha hai. [People will download the English Seekho app, but please make the payment, the order is getting delayed.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai... [Disclaimer: English Seekho is not endorsed, sponsored, affiliated or associated with any government authority, institution, brand, organisation or individual...]
summary: A delivery boy surprises a customer with his fluent English, explaining he learned it via the English Seekho app. He highlights the app's step-by-step lessons and AI coach for practice. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
